testResults.name: compiled-guardrail-assertions
testResults.command: PowerShell static assertions over az bicep build --stdout compiled ARM JSON
testResults.result: Compiled ARM assertions found seven-day Log Analytics retention; exact 40 USD and 70 USD monthly resource-group budgets with enabled actual-cost notifications at 100 percent; storage capacity 1099511627776 bytes with enqueue and ingest pause enabled; one backfill replica; one GiB maximum SQL scan; and 33554432-byte maximum SQL result. The runtime guardrail output exposes the same non-secret values for future T020 composition.

testResults.name: secret-free-and-scoped-boundary
testResults.result: The module contains no secret values, credentials, account keys, tokens, or Azure calls. Budget recipients are caller-supplied email or Action Group arrays and default to empty; storage-cap pause and SQL limits are explicit non-secret outputs for runtime enforcement rather than unsupported native Azure quotas.

assumptions: Azure Consumption budget notifications are percentage-based, so two independent monthly budgets at 40 USD and 70 USD use 100 percent actual-cost notifications to represent the plan's literal dollar alert amounts without inventing a separate monthly budget denominator.
T018 remains unchanged as required; T020 owns final module composition and should ensure the cost-controls workspace state is composed consistently with the Container Apps workspace resource.
The application must enforce storage-cap pause, one-replica backfill, and SQL scan/result limits because Azure does not expose native byte quotas for those runtime behaviors.
limitations: No Azure login, deployment, what-if, Cost Management operation, or data-plane call was run.
A deployment must provide at least one valid budget notification email or existing Action Group resource ID; Azure will reject empty recipient arrays even though they are safe offline defaults.

A deployment must provide budgetStartDate as the first day of the current or permitted monthly budget period, and the caller must have permission to write the resource-group Log Analytics workspace and Cost Management budgets.
T020 must compose the emitted runtimeGuardrails object into workload configuration; this task does not edit the existing Container Apps module.
